title: Financial Planning Analyst
description:
Chalk Hill Group are partnering with an established and growing organisation to recruit an FP&A Analyst into its Group Finance function.

This is an excellent opportunity to join a forward-thinking finance team in a role that combines financial planning, forecasting, financial modelling and strategic analysis. Working closely with senior finance stakeholders, you will play an important part in supporting business planning, investment decisions and the delivery of the Group's long-term financial strategy.

With exposure to senior stakeholders, treasury, investor relations and wider business operations, this is a varied role offering the opportunity to develop your strategic finance experience.

Key Responsibilities
  • Support the development and maintenance of the Group's long-term financial plan, budgets and forecasts.
  • Build and maintain financial models to support business planning, investment appraisal and strategic decision-making.
  • Produce financial analysis, scenario modelling and cash flow forecasts to assess business performance, funding requirements and future opportunities.
  • Prepare monthly and quarterly management reporting, including financial performance analysis, KPI reporting and variance commentary.
  • Support lender reporting, covenant monitoring, treasury analysis and future borrowing requirements.
  • Assist with regulatory submissions, annual financial forecasts and interest budget preparation.
  • Provide financial insight to support investment decisions, development programmes and business cases.
  • Contribute to board and committee reporting, presenting financial information clearly and effectively.
  • Identify opportunities to improve financial reporting, automation and data quality, making best use of Excel, Power BI and wider finance systems.
About You
  • Experience in an FP&A, financial planning, management accounting or analytical finance role.
  • Strong financial modelling and analytical skills, with the ability to interpret financial information and provide meaningful insight.
  • Experience of budgeting, forecasting, cash flow analysis and management reporting.
  • Advanced Excel skills, with experience of Power BI and financial reporting systems desirable.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to build relationships with stakeholders across a business.
  • A proactive approach to problem-solving, with a keen eye for detail and an interest in continuous improvement.
  • A relevant accountancy qualification (ACA, ACCA, CIMA) or working towards one would be advantageous.
The Opportunity
  • Salary of £50,000–£55,000 p/a
  • Highly flexible hybrid working, with just 2 days per month in the office.
  • Exposure to senior finance leaders and strategic business decisions.
  • A broad role spanning FP&A, financial modelling, treasury and corporate planning.
  • The opportunity to develop your experience within an established Group Finance function.

If you are an analytically minded finance professional looking for a role offering genuine strategic exposure alongside an excellent degree of flexibility, we would be keen to hear from you.
